Class WaterGrid

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.ecology.WaterGrid
public class WaterGrid extends Object
Manages water simulation including surface flow and tunnel flooding. Uses a simplified cellular automata for surface water and graph flow for tunnels.
